s1.desc: a snowy landscape with pine trees and rolling hills

spans.view: with an igloo's arched wooden door on the right

beats.text: Polly waddles across the snow from the left toward the igloo door
Polly stops beside the door, looks back and points off to the left with one flipper
Polly faces forward with her eyes closed and a pleased little smile
Polly turns to the igloo and pushes the wooden door open
Polly steps through the open doorway and disappears inside the igloo
The doorway stands empty while a tall stack of colorful boxes slides in at the left edge
Pax waddles in from the left carrying a tall stack of boxes and a net bag of groceries, pulling a loaded wagon

spans.notes: one locked shot for the whole skit: ECC on the igloo band 1.0000 / 0 px except while the door is open, and on the tree band under 1.5 px (drifting clouds). No lead visible f103-116 (only the box stack at the left edge). Ends at f143, where the Walmart-logo bag on Pax's wagon starts to enter

Pax's wagon carries a navy shopping bag with the yellow Walmart spark logo (edge visible from f143, logo legible ~f146 to the end), with a small dark penguin plush in a rose top peeking out of it (a Pudgy plush, possibly also lead_copy). Pax hauls the load up to the igloo door. Camera locked as in span 0
